title: MITIGATING THE SAFETY ALIGNMENT TAX WITH NULL-SPACE CONSTRAINED POLICY OPTIMIZATION
findings: The paper does not present any findings related to religion, as this was not a focus of the research. The findings demonstrate that the proposed method, Null-Space constrained Policy Optimization (NSPO), effectively mitigates the safety alignment tax, achieving strong safety performance without significantly degrading the model's general capabilities on tasks like math and coding.
